question: What does the evidence index cost on a real file?
consensus: Unmeasured by all nine; every companion reports finite-model counts only
variants: Clover measures 211 versus 16 ground instances in its model; Fennel, Juniper, Laurel measure the exponential family

question: Which registry rules fire?
consensus: Only model traces: two rules for the fourth coefficient, one more for the second; no Mathlib histogram
variants: Clover: seven-rule registry fires two; Heather: one implication in the toy resolver

question: Does simp break the anchor?
consensus: Three cases: definitional reuse, checked equality transport, consumer theorem or iff; keep the old anchor; never rekey by string
variants: Companions refuse all transport (Heather) or key on lexical context (Sorrel)

question: How is reification proved once for many checkers?
consensus: Share a typed syntax, environment, and bridge proof interface; each checker keeps its own denotation theorem
variants: Bryony factors a semiring core with typed extensions; Rowan uses dependent vectors for arity

question: What is the completeness theorem for each Leant abstraction?
consensus: Affine equality is complete relative to the admissible observation image, proved by a realizable frame; nothing is claimed for other contracts
variants: Rowan: finite unions of linear sets with constructed witnesses; Heather: rank lower bound; Alder: integer combinations into an abelian group

question: Where does almost-everywhere reasoning enter the row?
consensus: As a relation indexed by its measure, consumed by the integral-congruence theorem at that measure; no point evaluation; countable versus uncountable families
variants: Alder: a pointwise upgrade under continuity and full support; Sorrel: the Cauchy formula's a.e. replacement

question: Does a lexical structure context shorten the FLT preambles?
consensus: Proposed by all nine for meaning stability; measured by none

question: Can the closure theorem's rule generation be bounded?
consensus: Yes: a finite typed term pool, first-order templates, and an explicit bound; completeness is relative to the materialised rules
variants: Sorrel adds constructor depth; Bryony adds epochs; Juniper adds two completeness flags

question: What does a reader recover from the compact view?
consensus: A blind recovery test of domain, quantifiers, measure, branch, precision, and strength; not run

question: Is one implementation enough?
consensus: No; every companion has a separately written oracle, and none is an independent team or a Lean implementation

question: Which first use-site interface will we ship?
consensus: One property-implicit exact-quotient binder and method application, compared with an ordinary Lean helper
variants: Heather ships the behavioural slice first; Clover and Juniper first port their finite engines

question: What is the finite automatic fragment?
consensus: Ground Horn rules over a finite term pool; the frontier antichain (or closure) is complete only for the materialised rules
variants: Six antichain engines; three closure-only engines

question: What may inference decide about data?
consensus: Only authorized witness holes under a fixed specification; meaning-bearing holes are sealed
variants: Fennel and Rowan seal a metavariable-free target; the rest classify by dependency closure

question: How will required proof methods be checked?
consensus: A recipe tree or support-restricted helper; policy filtered before minimization; token occurrence is insufficient
variants: Alder proposes a derivation automaton; Sorrel an intensional plan certificate

question: Which behavioural bridge and completeness claim come first?
consensus: The list grammar with a proved affine length model and a realizable frame for the actual input type
variants: Heather ships four frames; Rowan semilinear unions; Alder integer frames

question: What authorizes negative Leant selection?
consensus: A realized admissible witness with the negative transfer direction, or a proof of the negation; model witnesses stay model-relative

question: Which nonalgebraic task is the first transfer test?
consensus: Local differentiation as the development case; a held-out task chosen after the freeze
variants: Bryony: weighted Fubini; Sorrel: the Cauchy formula; Juniper: inverse derivatives and quotient descent; Laurel: sharp Lipschitz; Fennel: q-Pochhammer

question: What evidence is retained and rechecked?
consensus: Target, context, structures, candidate, proof or certificate, dependencies, policy; rebuild per declaration first
variants: Laurel reopens used premises; Clover keys on the whole source text

question: What performance result would justify a larger checker or native execution?
consensus: None claimed; measure index, firing, growth, and rebuild against existing tactics under a chosen policy first

question: What outcome would end the separate-language experiment?
consensus: If L1, L2, or the renderer explains the gains, ship those; L3 is the type-layer test; L4 is the syntax test
